title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 8: C1 GLOBAL LEADERSHIP & STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION
description: An advanced communication world focused on strategic thinking, leadership, influence, stakeholder communication, international collaboration, and high-stakes professional decision-making.

targets.vocabulary: 4100+ active words with leadership, strategy, diplomacy, and organizational collocations
targets.reading: 2300–2900 words with strategic analysis, policy-style argument, and stakeholder perspectives
targets.listening: 23–29 minutes across leadership talks, negotiations, briefings, interviews, and panel discussions
targets.speaking: 28–36 minutes of leadership dialogue, strategic discussion, negotiation, and decision defense
targets.writing: 850–1050 words across strategic briefs, proposals, stakeholder updates, and analytical recommendations
targets.presentation: 14–18 minutes with executive-style structure, persuasion, visuals, and live Q&A
targets.leadershipCommunication: adapt tone, framing, evidence, and register to audience, objective, urgency, and cultural context

grammar: advanced modal systems for obligation, probability, strategic recommendation, and risk
modal perfects and conditional structures for scenario planning and hindsight
complex passive and reporting structures for institutional and stakeholder communication
nominalization and dense noun phrases for concise strategic writing
inversion, fronting, clefting, and emphasis for persuasive communication
advanced concession, qualification, hedging, and boosting for calibrated claims
ellipsis, substitution, parallelism, and cohesion in high-level discourse
complex relative and participial structures for information compression
pragmatic choices for diplomacy, authority, disagreement, and relationship management
register shifting across executive, collaborative, public-facing, and cross-cultural contexts

missions.title: Strategic Vocabulary Command
missions.focus: Leadership, strategy, priorities, resources, risk, and stakeholder vocabulary
missions.outcome: Use precise strategic language to frame complex organizational situations.

missions.title: Vision & Mission Lab
missions.focus: Explaining purpose, long-term direction, values, and measurable objectives
missions.outcome: Communicate a clear vision while connecting abstract goals to concrete actions.

missions.title: Strategic Priorities Arena
missions.focus: Ranking goals, allocating attention, explaining trade-offs, and setting boundaries
missions.outcome: Defend priorities using concise reasoning and evidence-aware language.

missions.title: Stakeholder Intelligence Mission
missions.focus: Identifying interests, concerns, influence, expectations, and communication needs
missions.outcome: Adapt messages to different stakeholders without changing the underlying facts.

missions.title: Influence Without Pressure
missions.focus: Persuasion, framing, credibility, reciprocity, and respectful influence
missions.outcome: Present compelling arguments while preserving trust and professional relationships.

missions.title: High-Stakes Negotiation Lab
missions.focus: Interests, concessions, conditions, alternatives, and agreement language
missions.outcome: Navigate complex negotiations using precise, diplomatic C1 communication.

missions.title: Executive Decision Briefing
missions.focus: Concise problem framing, options, evidence, risks, and recommendations
missions.outcome: Deliver a decision-ready briefing that separates facts, assumptions, and recommendations.

missions.title: Difficult Conversation Command
missions.focus: Accountability, performance concerns, boundaries, empathy, and next steps
missions.outcome: Handle sensitive conversations with clarity, respect, and appropriate authority.

missions.title: Cross-Cultural Leadership Lab
missions.focus: Communication expectations, directness, hierarchy, face, and cultural adaptation
missions.outcome: Lead international interactions while reducing avoidable communication friction.

missions.title: Leadership Q&A Arena
missions.focus: Spontaneous questions, challenge, clarification, reframing, and concise response
missions.outcome: Respond confidently when questions are difficult, unexpected, or strategically sensitive.

missions.title: Global Strategy Reading Lab
missions.focus: Strategic reports, stakeholder analysis, policy-style texts, and competing priorities
missions.outcome: Identify strategic assumptions, risks, evidence, and implications in complex texts.

missions.title: Leadership Listening Under Pressure
missions.focus: Briefings, interviews, negotiations, panels, and rapidly changing information
missions.outcome: Track priorities, speaker stance, implied meaning, and action points in real time.

missions.title: Strategic Brief Writing
missions.focus: Executive summaries, situation analysis, options, risks, and recommendations
missions.outcome: Write concise strategic briefs that support informed decision-making.

missions.title: Stakeholder Communication Lab
missions.focus: Announcements, updates, difficult news, reassurance, and expectation management
missions.outcome: Communicate complex developments clearly to audiences with different priorities.

missions.title: Global Presentation Command
missions.focus: Persuasive structure, narrative, evidence, visuals, delivery, and Q&A
missions.outcome: Deliver a compelling strategic presentation to an international audience.

missions.title: Crisis Leadership Simulation
missions.focus: Uncertainty, rapid decisions, public communication, accountability, and recovery
missions.outcome: Coordinate communication when facts are incomplete and priorities are changing.

missions.title: Global Change & Transformation
missions.focus: Organizational change, technology, sustainability, workforce shifts, and adaptation
missions.outcome: Explain change strategies while addressing uncertainty, resistance, and competing interests.

missions.title: International Leadership Council
missions.focus: Multi-stakeholder roundtable, compromise, coalition building, and final agreement
missions.outcome: Coordinate a complex international discussion toward a workable shared outcome.

missions.title: World 8 Integrated Leadership Marathon
missions.focus: Strategic reading, listening, negotiation, briefing, writing, and presentation
missions.outcome: Demonstrate sustained C1 performance across a multi-stage leadership challenge.

missions.title: WORLD 8 MASTER QUEST — C1 GLOBAL LEADERSHIP & STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION
missions.focus: Full strategic scenario from diagnosis through negotiation, decision, communication, and defense
missions.outcome: Complete an integrated leadership mission using precise, adaptive, diplomatic, and persuasive C1 English.

realWorldScenarios: Explaining a long-term vision to a diverse team
Choosing between competing priorities under limited resources
Briefing decision-makers on risks and strategic options
Communicating an unpopular but necessary change
Responding to challenging questions from stakeholders
Managing communication during a fast-moving crisis
Presenting a strategic transformation plan to an international audience

components: advanced grammar and pragmatic register control
assessment.successCriteria: Learner communicates strategically and diplomatically in complex global contexts, adapting language, structure, tone, evidence, and level of directness to audience, objective, risk, and cultural setting.
